_about: The Build's starter door: what someone with no thing yet sees. Four cards, one per slot, in this order: a Top 100+ mission, a run club or fitness meet this week, an Up For It idea that tipped, a neighbor's public thing. Four things, never a catalog.

Each slot reads its source by the rules below. A slot with nothing usable (no tipped idea, no public things yet, a source that failed to load) takes the next unused card from fallbacks instead, so the door always shows four.

Pick once per Burlington week (Monday to Sunday), seeded by the week's Monday date, so the door holds still for a week and does not reshuffle on every visit. A card the reader picked or dismissed does not come back that week.
Picking a card names the thing (title), fills its first step (first_step) as the clock_in placeholder, and keeps the source link on the thing card. The reader can edit both before saving.

Paths are relative to all-day/index.html, the same as What Now and People use. Stephen edits fallbacks by hand; each one carries a checked block saying where its facts were read and when. Re-check any fallback older than 120 days, and drop one whose until date has passed.

mission.keep: needs_check is false, the reader has not marked it done (the same marks What Now keeps under localStorage 'allday-missions', by the mission's mark), and the current Burlington month is in season_months for its mark when it has one
mission.prefer: themes free, culture, play and outdoors over eat and drink, since a thing to work toward fits them better; then the week's seed

season_months._note: Missions carry no months of their own. These marks only show in these months, read from each mission's own paragraph, so nobody is sent to a beach in January or a frozen pond in July. Any mark not listed shows all year.

meet.how: clubs-week.js meetsInWindow(clubs, now, now + 7 days), the same week People shows; the demo file goes through redateDemo first. Season, months, from, until and skip are already handled there.
meet.keep: a meet that has not started yet, from a club whose newcomers field is not empty, whose what, schedule_note and meet note do not match /dads only|members[- ]only|join first/i
meet.prefer: the soonest run club meet (kind run); when there is none this week, the soonest of any kind

upforit.how: POST with body {} and the same publishable anon key What Now already ships (headers apikey and Authorization: Bearer). Read only. Fails soft to a fallback.
upforit.keep: tipped_at is set, status is live or claimed, and months is empty or includes the current Burlington month

card.title: title
card.link: https://play.btownbrief.com/up-for-it/?plan={plan_id} when plan_id is set, else https://play.btownbrief.com/up-for-it/

upforit.first_step: Tap I'd go, then pick a night
upforit.demo: skip the network and take the fake backend's tipped idea if it seeds one, else a fallback
upforit._checked: 2026-10-21: the RPC answered with 30 ideas (27 live, 3 exists) and none tipped yet, so today this slot falls through to a fallback.

public.from: builder A's data layer (bd_*). The Build's contract has no call for this yet: it needs a small public read, for example bd_public_things(), returning things whose owner has posted about them at least once (the spec's rule for when a thing's name goes public), with the owner's first name only when bd_builder.first_name_public is true.
public.keep: not the reader's own thing, not from someone they blocked, posted about in the last 30 days, status active or done
public.prefer: a Finished thing first, then the one with the newest post

card.title: thing title
card.line_no_name: A neighbor is working on this

public.why: The spec wants a line on why they picked it. The why is written privately on the thing card, so show it here only if the owner says yes to sharing it (a per-thing switch A would need to add). Until that exists, leave the why off.
public.first_step: Name your own version of it

fallbacks.title: Learn to contra dance
fallbacks.first_step: Go to one Friday dance and get there for the 6:45 lesson
fallbacks.line: Every dance is taught and nobody needs a partner, so the first night is the whole lesson.

checked.note: Fri Oct 23 at St. Anthony's Parish Hall, 305 Flynn Ave; Nov 27 and Dec 18 at Shelburne Town Hall. Beginner lesson 6:45, dancing 7 to 10. 'All dances are taught; no partner or experience necessary.' $12 adults, $5 ages 12 to 18 or limited budget, under 12 free. No dates posted past Dec 18.

fallbacks.title: Run a Vermont City Marathon relay with friends
fallbacks.first_step: Find one to four people who'd split it with you
fallbacks.line: A team of two to five splits the marathon, so a first timer trains for a piece of it with friends.

checked.note: Race date page: 'Sunday, May 30th', 7:10 AM, Waterfront Park (2027). Main page: '2 person or 3-5 person relays'.

fallbacks.title: Do the Penguin Plunge for Special Olympics Vermont
fallbacks.first_step: Register and send your page to three people
fallbacks.line: It comes with a date, a fundraising goal of at least $250 and a crowd jumping in with you.

checked.note: Page title '2027 Penguin Plunge'. 'All plungers must commit to raising the minimum of $250.' Plungers under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the waiver. The site's text does not show the date; missions.json (m285) says Saturday, February 6, 2027.

fallbacks.title: Run with the Long Trail Running Club on a Thursday
fallbacks.first_step: Join on Meetup and pick this Thursday's run
fallbacks.line: All paces, all year, and they wait at the turns and hilltops so nobody gets left behind.

checked.note: 'Our Thursday night social runs continue throughout the year.' Headlamps required in fall and winter. 'All paces welcome'; 'we wait at turns or the tops of hills.' $5 a year, charged through Meetup; start points posted on Meetup for members.

fallbacks.title: Play Wednesday pickup basketball with the Btown Brief crew
fallbacks.first_step: RSVP on Meetup and bring $12 for the day pass
fallbacks.line: Stephen's own weekly run, 5:30 to 7:30 at Gutterson, and a quick way to meet people in town.

checked.note: 'Wednesday, Oct 21 · 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM EDT. Every week on Wednesday until March 10, 2027. Gutterson Fieldhouse, 147 Spear St.' 'A day pass is $12 per person, paid at the Campus Rec front desk in the Gucciardi Fitness Center.' Hosted by Steve D.

fallbacks.title: Learn disc golf at Awasiwi Woods
fallbacks.first_step: Play the short grey tees once, all nine baskets
fallbacks.line: Nine baskets in the woods in South Burlington, with short tees for a first round.

checked.note: Behind the Munsen Field track at the middle and high school campus. 'Two 18-tee course layouts, regular and long, with 9 baskets.' Grey boards mark the short course, blue the long. 'Open dawn to dusk.' The page does not state a fee. Months are ours, for snow.

fallbacks.title: Finish the craft project in the closet
fallbacks.first_step: Bring it to The Makery's craft night
fallbacks.line: A free craft night at The Makery on Pine, no signup, gives the project a table and some company.

checked.note: 'Bring your own Craft Night. Free! No registration Required.' The page lists no date for the next one; missions.json (m293) says it is monthly, at 388 Pine Street.

fallbacks.title: Set foot in every Burlington city park
fallbacks.first_step: Pick the three closest parks you've never been to
fallbacks.line: Each park is a short trip, and the list tells you when you're done.

checked.note: Challenge park-passport: 'set foot in every Burlington city park', verified true, on the challenge board. Also listed in all-day/data/challenges.json evergreen.

fallbacks.title: Walk the Btown Brief walking tour, start to finish
fallbacks.first_step: Pick an afternoon and start at stop one
fallbacks.line: About 1.7 miles and two hours, so it's a whole finished thing in one afternoon.

checked.note: 'Roughly 1.7 miles, mostly flat with one climb back up from the lake. Budget 90–120 minutes at a casual pace.' 13 stops.

fallbacks.title: Give one hour a week somewhere in town
fallbacks.first_step: Pick one place from the volunteer guide and email them
fallbacks.line: An hour has a clear finish line, and it's the fastest way to know people by name.

checked.note: The guide's volunteer page (data/volunteers/orgs.json). Same idea as the weekly challenge w-give-an-hour, 'Volunteer one hour somewhere in town this week.'

fallbacks.title: Borrow a tool and fix the thing that's been broken
fallbacks.first_step: Look up the tool in South Burlington's Library of Things
fallbacks.line: The South Burlington library lends tools on a library card, so one repair doesn't mean buying a tool.

checked.note: 'A collection of items, such as games, consumer electronics, and tools, that you can check out with your library card.' Second floor near the DVDs; holds through the catalog.
